title: Technology: Open MRI

slides.title: How open MRI is different.
steps: You lie on a padded table with open space around you, not inside a tube.
A friend or family member can sit in the room with you.
Comfortable for larger bodies, and for kids who want a parent close.
slides.footnote: Your companion must have no metal implants or devices. Open MRI in Seminole (Hitachi Airis 2).

slides.title: What it feels like.
items: Loud tapping and humming is normal. Earplugs or music help.
No radiation, just magnets and radio waves.
Get right back to your day afterward.

slides.title: Before your open MRI
items: Leave jewelry and watches at home.
Tell us about a pacemaker, implant, stent or any metal in your body.
Wear comfy clothes with no metal, or change into a gown.
Very anxious? Ask your doctor about medicine to help you relax.
slides.footnote: Arrive 15 minutes early. Source: NIH MedlinePlus, MRI scan.

slides.title: Simple to book in Seminole.
slides.footnote: Same price as our other MRIs, radiologist reading included. With insurance, a doctor's order is needed.

What it feels like: loud tapping and humming is normal and earplugs or music help; most scans take 30 to 60 minutes; no radiation, just magnets and radio waves; get right back to your day afterward.
